context:
tests/uat/phases/execute.py already exports BENCHBOX_DATA_DIR for managed
platforms, so the default is redundant. Replace it with the required form
${BENCHBOX_DATA_DIR:?...} so an unset variable fails loudly at compose parse time
instead of silently mounting the wrong path. Then sweep all compose files for the
nested pattern and add a lint test rejecting it repo-wide.
description:
Supersedes lakesail-compose-nested-variable-default, dropped the same day: verification ladders are
create-time-only in this tracker, so a lint finding on a rung can only be
fixed by recreating the item.

docker/lakesail/docker-compose.yml line 23 nests defaults two deep:
  - "${BENCHBOX_DATA_DIR:-${PWD}/benchmark_runs}:${BENCHBOX_DATA_DIR:-${PWD}/benchmark_runs}:ro"

mocker's compose parser does not handle the nested form and resolves it to a
doubled path with a stray brace, failing with:
  path '/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/benchmark_runs}' does not exist

LakeSail therefore cannot start under mocker at all, independently of the
container-name and readiness defects.

MEASURED 2026-08-05: the identical nested-default pattern is also present in
docker/velox/docker-compose.yml, so this is not a lakesail-only defect.

anti_patterns.instead: sweep all compose files and add a lint that rejects the pattern
anti_patterns.why: the same nested pattern may exist in other compose files and will fail identically the first time that platform runs under mocker

anti_patterns.dont: replace the nested default with a hardcoded absolute path
anti_patterns.instead: require the variable and let the caller supply it
anti_patterns.why: it bakes one developer's directory layout into a committed compose file

anti_patterns.dont: silently default to ./benchmark_runs when the variable is unset
anti_patterns.instead: fail at parse time with a message naming the missing variable
anti_patterns.why: a silently wrong mount path is how this defect stayed hidden -- the container started and read nothing

preserves.behavior: Behavior under real Docker is unchanged when BENCHBOX_DATA_DIR is exported, which UAT always does.
The LakeSail CSV compatibility symlink layout under the data directory is untouched.
The mount stays read-only and maps BENCHBOX_DATA_DIR to the identical absolute path inside the container, which is what makes server-side absolute paths resolve.

prior_art.concept: existing helper module for compose path handling in UAT; the lint belongs with it or with the docker asset tests rather than in a new harness
already exports BENCHBOX_DATA_DIR into the compose environment, which is why the in-file default can be removed rather than rewritten

verifications.command: uv run python -c "import re,pathlib;bad=[str(p) for p in pathlib.Path('docker').rglob('docker-compose*.yml') if re.search(r'[\$]\{[^}]*[\$]\{', p.read_text())];assert not bad, bad"
verifications.description: No compose file under docker/ contains a nested variable default
verifications.expected: FAILS (exit 1) on the unfixed tree: docker/lakesail and docker/velox both carry nested variable defaults that mocker misparses. Exits 0 once both are removed.

verifications.command: uv run python -c "import re,pathlib;bad=[str(p) for p in pathlib.Path('docker').rglob('docker-compose*.yml') if re.search(r'\\$\\{[^}]*\\$\\{', p.read_text())];assert not bad, bad"
verifications.description: No compose file under docker/ contains a nested variable default
verifications.expected: exit 0; the nested-default pattern is absent repo-wide

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/uat/test_docker_path_helpers.py tests/uat/test_docker_assets.py -q
verifications.description: Compose path helper tests pass including the nested-default lint
verifications.expected: all pass; a test rejects the nested pattern

work_units.evidence: Nested default removed from docker/lakesail and docker/velox. NOT replaced with the required-variable form: review proved mocker 0.7.2 leaves the ${VAR:?msg} form completely unsubstituted even when the variable IS set, exiting 0. Landed as a flat no-default ${BENCHBOX_DATA_DIR} plus absolute-path validation at every bring-up path.
work_units.summary: Replace the lakesail nested default with the required-variable form

work_units.evidence: Swept every compose file under docker/: lakesail and velox both carried the nested pattern; both fixed. No others found.
work_units.summary: Sweep every compose file for the nested pattern and fix any others

work_units.evidence: Three repo-wide lint guards in tests/uat/docker_path_helpers.py: the pre-existing nested-default scan, plus find_non_flat_benchbox_data_dir_mounts (catches colon-less POSIX forms, no allowlist) and find_env_files_with_non_absolute_data_dir (globs *.env and .env.*, flags relative AND empty). Enforcement also moved into compose_environment(), the choke point uat_bring_up and the sweep both use. 7-case mutation matrix all caught; tests/uat 633 passed.
work_units.summary: Add a repo-wide lint test rejecting nested variable defaults
